tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Newest-first headlines from worldwide sources, optionally filtered by words, language, country, topic, source, kind and time.

tools.name: sync_news
tools.description: Incremental feed: returns items added after `after`, oldest first, plus a new cursor. Call again with that cursor to get only what is new.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: The most widely covered stories right now (last 48h), each with a neutral multi-source brief when available, outlet count, languages, entities and a representative report. Filter by lang, country, category, entity.

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Look up Wikidata ids for a name (e.g. "Tesla", "Lagos") with how many items mention each in the last 7 days; pass the id as `entity` to search_news or list_stories.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Every item in a story (the `story` id on items, st_…): all outlets and languages covering the same event, newest first.

tools.name: find_prospects
tools.description: The companies and people in an article or a story, ready to add to CRM by Hottub. Each has add_url (CRM by Hottub's add form, filled in; the person presses Add) and propose (arguments for CRM by Hottub's propose_relationship tool, which an owner approves). Give item (n_… or s_…) or story (st_…); or

tools.name: get_news_item
tools.description: Full record for one item id (n_… for news, s_… for sponsored).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Registered sources with their language, country, kind and health. Filter by q (name), country or lang.

tools.name: quote_placement
tools.description: Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the News by Hottub mix via Hottub Business. tools.name: newsmap
tools.description: What the news covered in a period, for the world or a region: reports counted by publisher country (a choropleth map, as links to SVG and PNG) and the most widely covered stories with outlet counts. tools.description: The last 24 hours, country by country, like an election map: each country's leading story (the one the most of its own outlets covered), the stories leading in the most countries, and countries too quiet to call. tools.name: news_stats
tools.description: Item counts over the last 24 hours by kind, language, country and source, plus the current sync cursor.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_placement" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the Hottub News mix via Hottub Business. Price varies by topic tier, current topic interest, demand, targeting reach and duration; the response itemizes each factor. Read-only: returns a price; books and charges nothing." → after: "Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the News by Hottub mix via Hottub Business.
